value.body: Public sector undertakings recruit HR executive trainees and officers to handle recruitment, industrial relations, training, payroll and welfare. Several large PSUs, such as POWERGRID, have filled these posts using UGC-NET scores in Human Resource Management / Labour Welfare followed by an interview.

items.label: Usual qualification
items.value: PG in HR / personnel management / IR
items.note: Often a 2-year MBA or PG diploma with HR specialisation, or MSW with HR

items.label: Upper age (example)
items.note: POWERGRID HR trainee notice; varies by PSU

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A BBA alone is usually not enough — most PSU HR posts ask for a postgraduate degree with HR specialisation and minimum marks. Watch PSU notifications that name the UGC-NET cycle they will use, appear in that NET paper, and clear the interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are few and irregular, and each PSU sets its own eligibility and cut-offs.
The usual route from a BBA is an MBA (HR) or similar PG first.
PSU HR work includes labour-law compliance and union relations, especially in plant locations.
